senses.en_definition: Coffee; a drink made by brewing ground coffee beans in water.
A coffee plant (Coffea species), its fruit or seeds, or the beans or grounds used to make coffee.
Colloquial: a copy or reproduction of an original document, picture, or similar item.

collocations.en: a copy of an application letter

senses.en_definition: A manuscript of a book intended for publication.

collocations.en: prepare a manuscript for the publisher
submit a manuscript to the editor

messages.en: I'm at the coffee shop. What would you like to drink? I'll get yours to go as well.
One hot black coffee, no sugar, please. Yesterday's was way too sweet.
Okay, I'll order it without sugar. I'll message you when I get to the office.

senses.en_definition: Hollow; having an empty space inside.
Zero; the number 0, especially when reading out numbers or scores.
Vacant, unoccupied, or unused; blank or unwritten on.
Empty; lacking substance, significance, or sincerity.
Emotionally empty; unable to feel pleasure, happiness, or other emotions.
Plain; served without certain customary ingredients, fillings, or additions, depending on the food or drink.

messages.en: Are you inside yet? Are there any free tables? I've just arrived.
There's one at the back. I'll grab it—just come on in.

senses.en_definition: A fort or fortress enclosed by stone walls.
Classical Malay: a defensive wall surrounding a fort.

collocations.en: the height of the fortress wall

senses.en_definition: A city or town; an urban area.

messages.en: Living in this big city is exhausting. Traffic jams every day—it even takes ages to get home.
I know. Can we head out a bit earlier tomorrow? Let's leave at seven.

senses.en_definition: A box; a container with a lid, usually rectangular or square and made of cardboard, wood, or metal.
A square or rectangular space, compartment, or section marked off from its surroundings.

messages.en: Hey, big brother, this box of books is so heavy. I can't lift it on my own.
Hang on, I'm coming. Don't lift it yet—we'll lift it together.
Okay, the box is by the door. I'll wait here.
